# Rules Model

## Purpose
The Rules Model (Scenarios) provides entities for defining automation rules, triggers, and actions. It supports complex event processing through scenarios.

## Key Entities
- **Scenario**: A container for a set of triggers and actions.
- **ScenarioTrigger**: Defines the condition under which a scenario starts.
- **ScenarioAction**: Defines the work to be performed when a scenario is triggered.
- **DataSource**: Provides data for scenario evaluation.
- **JSFunction**: Allows custom logic to be defined in JavaScript.

## Class Diagram
```mermaid
classDiagram
    Baseclass <|-- Scenario
    Baseclass <|-- ScenarioTrigger
    Baseclass <|-- ScenarioAction
    Baseclass <|-- DataSource
    Baseclass <|-- JSFunction
    Baseclass <|-- ScenarioToTrigger
    Baseclass <|-- ScenarioToAction
    Baseclass <|-- ScenarioToDataSource

    Scenario "1" *-- "many" ScenarioToTrigger
    ScenarioToTrigger "many" -- "1" ScenarioTrigger
    Scenario "1" *-- "many" ScenarioToAction
    ScenarioToAction "many" -- "1" ScenarioAction
    Scenario "1" *-- "many" ScenarioToDataSource
    ScenarioToDataSource "many" -- "1" DataSource
    
    ScenarioTrigger "many" -- "1" JSFunction : evaluatingJSCode
    ScenarioAction "many" -- "1" JSFunction : evaluatingJSCode

    class Scenario {
        +String name
        +String logPath
    }
    class ScenarioTrigger {
        +String name
        +JSFunction evaluatingJSCode
    }
    class JSFunction {
        +String methodBody
        +String name
    }
```
